import os
from uuid import uuid4
import asyncpg
import pytest

from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._base import ToolContext
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools.mindmap_work_list import MindmapWorkListTool, MindmapWorkListInput
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools.mindmap_work_get import MindmapWorkGetTool, MindmapWorkGetInput

pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not os.getenv("MEM_MCP_TEST_DSN"), reason="no dsn")

async def _setup(conn):
    tenant = await conn.fetchval("INSERT INTO tenants (email) VALUES ($1) RETURNING id", f"t-{uuid4()}@example.test")
    team = await conn.fetchval("INSERT INTO teams (name, created_by_tenant_id) VALUES ($1,$2) RETURNING id", f"team-{uuid4().hex[:8]}", tenant)
    await conn.execute("INSERT INTO team_role_assignments (parent_team_id, member_kind, member_id, role_id, status, assigned_by_user_id) SELECT $1,'user',$2,(SELECT id FROM roles_catalog WHERE role_key='owner' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1),'active',$2", team, tenant)
    await conn.execute("INSERT INTO tenant_identities (tenant_id, cognito_sub, provider, email, is_primary, default_team_id) VALUES ($1,$2,'cognito',$3,true,$4)", tenant, f"sub-{tenant}", f"e-{tenant}@example.test", team)
    root = await conn.fetchval("INSERT INTO memories (tenant_id, team_id, content, content_hash, embedding, source_kind, type, visibility) VALUES ($1,$2,'Root',$3,array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[1024])::vector,'api','question','team') RETURNING id", tenant, team, f"h-{uuid4()}")
    child = await conn.fetchval("INSERT INTO memories (tenant_id, team_id, content, content_hash, embedding, source_kind, type, visibility) VALUES ($1,$2,'Child',$3,array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[1024])::vector,'api','note','team') RETURNING id", tenant, team, f"h2-{uuid4()}")
    await conn.execute("INSERT INTO memory_maps (root_memory_id, tenant_id, team_id, title, state) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'M','live')", root, tenant, team)
    await conn.execute("INSERT INTO memory_map_membership (memory_id, root_memory_id, tenant_id, node_role) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'position')", child, root, tenant)
    map_key = f"map-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    await conn.execute("INSERT INTO slugs (memory_id, team_id, resource_type, slug, title) VALUES ($1,$2,'map',$3,'M')", root, team, map_key)
    return tenant, team, map_key, child

async def test_smoke(pg_pool):
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            tenant, team, map_key, node = await _setup(conn)
    # mark node as work item
    from mem_mcp.mcp.tools.mindmap_work_mark import MindmapWorkMarkTool, MindmapWorkMarkInput
    from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._deps import NoopQuotas, ToolDeps
    from mem_mcp.audit.logger import NoopAuditLogger
    class Stub:
        async def embed(self, content):
            from mem_mcp.embeddings.bedrock import EmbedResult
            return EmbedResult(vector=[0.0]*1024, input_tokens=1)
    deps = ToolDeps(embeddings=Stub(), audit=NoopAuditLogger(), quotas=NoopQuotas())
    ctx = ToolContext(db_pool=pg_pool, tenant_id=tenant, identity_id=tenant, client_id="c", request_id="r", deps=deps)
    await MindmapWorkMarkTool()(ctx, MindmapWorkMarkInput(map_key=map_key, node_id=node, kind="story", team_id=team))
    # list
    out = await MindmapWorkListTool()(ctx, MindmapWorkListInput(map_key=map_key, team_id=team))
    assert out.items
    item = out.items[0]
    assert item.current_stage is not None
    assert isinstance(item.allowed_moves, list)
    # get
    out2 = await MindmapWorkGetTool()(ctx, MindmapWorkGetInput(map_key=map_key, node_id=node, team_id=team))
    assert out2.node_id == node
    # not a work item
    other = uuid4()
    # create a node not work item
    # map not found
    try:
        await MindmapWorkGetTool()(ctx, MindmapWorkGetInput(map_key="nope", node_id=node, team_id=team))
        assert False
    except Exception as e:
        from mem_mcp.mcp.errors import JsonRpcError
        assert isinstance(e, JsonRpcError)
        assert e.code == -32602
